agent.reasons: Beneficial ownership is not complete under 3.3. Nobody is named for 30% of the shares, which is enough for an unidentified person to own 25% or more. Granite Holdings LLC holds 44%, but its owners are unknown and nothing shows it is an excluded entity, so its owners could include someone with 25% or more indirectly. The other checks raise no issues: the control person is identified, Mateo Weiss's ID is verified, the registry filing is under 12 months old, screening is clear, the industry is normal and the geography is US.

Ownership breakdown of Granite Holdings LLC (or evidence that it is an excluded entity)
Identity verification and screening for any new individuals who own 25% or more
Search records (terms, date, sources) for the adverse-media checks on the entity and Mateo Weiss, as 4.4 requires
